$comment: The entry `ef-install-settings` merges into a consuming repository's .claude/settings.json, verbatim. This file exists because the marketplace NAME is not derivable from the plugin payload: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json lives at the marketplace repository root and is never copied into a consumer's plugin cache. tests/validate-plugin.mjs asserts every value here against marketplace.json and plugin.json, so the two cannot drift, and asserts autoUpdate stays true - losing it is silent, and every repository configured afterwards would quietly stop receiving releases. See docs/constraints.md C20 for what that key actually scopes to.
